title: Words in orbit
description: A quiet circular label turns around a stationary center.
useCase: Create a decorative seal, event identity or compact editorial accent.
interaction: Play to turn the circular label
reducedMotion: The full circular label remains in its authored position.
limitations: Best for a short decorative phrase. Preserve the accessible full-text label and keep important copy in ordinary reading order.
look: Pale beige page with small, widely spaced olive capitals arranged in a ring around a thin line-drawn atom emblem.
motion: The ring of letters rotates clockwise around the fixed centre emblem in a 28 s linear CSS loop, pausing when the host deactivates it.
adapt: The spin is the `sf-spinning-text-turn` keyframe on `sf-spinning-text-ring` (28s linear); each letter of `text` is placed with a per-index `rotate` and `translateY(-80px)`, so retune that radius with the phrase length. Replace the phrase and atom SVG; keep the ring's `aria-label`.
